mapper.sql: id, forecast_date, slot_hour, weather_code, source_weather_ids, is_active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM weather_schedules WHERE forecast_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY forecast_date ASC, slot_hour ASC
SELECT FROM weather_schedules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY forecast_date ASC, slot_hour ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO weather_schedules ( forecast_date, slot_hour, weather_code, source_weather_ids, is_active ) VALUES ( #{forecastDate}, #{slotHour}, #{weatherCode}, #{sourceWeatherIds}, TRUE ) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE weather_code = new.weather_code, source_weather_ids = new.source_weather_ids, is_active = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE weather_schedules SET is_active = FALSE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
